title: Senior Artificial Intelligence (A.I.) Engineer
job_description: Preferred Skills as below: Computing and Analyzing Data on large scale. Ability to Experiment and Investigate technological advancement in Artifcial Intelligence, Deep Learning Neural Network and Recurrent Neural Network. Run, Deploy, Refine and Validate A.I. models in python coding. Understand and recommend solutions (predictive and prescriptive analytics) on Data gathering and Computation. Adept and knowledgeable in Cloud Computing (AWS, Google Colab, etc) Passionate on new age Artificial Intelligence in conducting research involving experimentation and modelling. Able to build A.I. Learning models and run based on data provided. Realise your potential in conceptualising computational and maths-related problems and challenges Hands on experience gain in developing new products or solving practical computing problems Interest in Artificial Intelligence in conducting research involving experimentation and modelling. Ability to work as part of a research team with professors, pHD students, programmers, IT professionals and software engineers to solve problems and create new products. Job Types: Full-time, Permanent, Contract Pay: RM5,000.00 - RM7,500.00 per month Benefits: Additional leave Flexible schedule Opportunities for promotion Professional development Work from home Education: Bachelor's (Preferred) Experience: Cloud Computing: 1 year (Preferred) Python Coding: 2 years (Preferred) Model Deployment: 2 years (Preferred) Work Location: In person
